title: What Closes in Berlin in Winter - Quick Summary
items: **Berlin closes in stages, not on one date.** Between mid-September and late November each operator runs its own calendar, so the honest question is which stage your trip lands in, not whether the city is open.

**The water goes first and it goes fast.** In 2026 the Sommerbäder at Humboldthain, Insulaner and Pankow had their last day on 11 September, and Neukölln, Gropiusstadt and the Strandbad Wannsee bathing season ended on 13 September.
**One outdoor pool keeps going until 30 October.** Sommerbad Kreuzberg, the Prinzenbad, sits beside U-Bahn Prinzenstraße on the U1 and is heated. It is the best outdoor swim in Berlin in October.
**The clocks going back on 25 October is the real switch.** Zoo Berlin runs to 18:00 with last admission at 17:00 until that Sunday, then drops to 16:30 with last admission at 15:30 from 26 October.

**Gates close earlier than the sights do.** Tempelhofer Feld runs 07:00 to 19:00 in October and 07:30 to 17:00 in December and January. The Botanic Garden closes its exits at 19:00 from 1 October, and once they are shut you cannot leave the garden.

**November hands things back.** The public saunas in the city pools open on 1 November, the Spree winter city tour runs Friday to Sunday from 20 November to 20 December, and the Christmas markets start on 23 November.
